statement: Fix constants C0 ≥ 1, c0 > 0, and L ≥ 1. There are constants B0, K, C ≥ 1 and n1, depending only on these three constants, with the following property. Let n ≥ n1, let (X, µ) be an atomless finite measure space, and let (Ci)i∈I be an indexed list of measurable sets with 0 < ci := µ(Ci) < ∞ and 1 ≤ m := |I| ≤ n2. Set c̄i = min(ci, 1/2), si = − log c̄i, and let d be a pseudometric on I. For nonempty S ⊆ I, write r(S) = min j∈S max i∈S d(i, j)2 , and choose an index i(S) ∈ S minimizing the uncapped measure ci.
